name: Lamplighter (Example)
author: voodoo573
description: EXAMPLE ITEM. You spent your youth walking the streets at dusk, lighting the lamps and learning every alley, rooftop and shortcut in town.

feature.name: Light in the Dark
feature.desc: You know the streets of any town you have lived in by heart, and town watchmen and lamplighters will usually point you the right way.
